mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate exceeding 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and driving negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.2pp over 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings face headwinds.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime (industrial production growth below 0.5% monthly), a decline in industrial output signals manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days as corporate margins compress.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during supply-constrained regimes when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in real GDP (GDPC1) above 1.0% annualized rate signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.0% annualized, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained acceleration in CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 0.3 percentage points over three months signals rising inflation pressures, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises > 0.3pp over 3 months, or Rank IC is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days as consumer spending and business investment falter.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-supply-growth regime (INDPRO growth above 1.0% monthly), a decline in industrial production signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as supply chain disruptions weigh on earnings.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during high-supply-growth regimes when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC is below 0.02.
